title: Forged from the Love of Liberty

local: Forged from the love of liberty
In the fires of hope and prayer
With boundless faith in our destiny
english: Forged from the love of liberty
In the fires of hope and prayer

local: Islands of the blue Caribbean sea,
We pledge our lives to thee.
english: Islands of the blue Caribbean sea,
We pledge our lives to thee.

local: Here every creed and race find an equal place,
And may God bless our nation.
english: Here every creed and race find an equal place,
And may God bless our nation.
